sub_answers.text: The Junior National Wheelchair Games were established with instrumental support from John Grant while he was president of the Paraplegic and Quadriplegic Association of New South Wales.[d37675808s4p0] Grant played a role in including sports in rehabilitation programs at Mount Wilga House, which held annual Sports Days.[d37675808s4p0] Grant advocated for a national policy on sport for people with disabilities, leading to the establishment of a national advisory committee on sports for disabled persons on which he served.[d37675808s4p0]

Coaches begin training cycles with a general physical preparedness phase that targets all major muscles and joints [d5568077s1p0].
GPP is scheduled at the start of macrocycles, mesocycles and microcycles after restoration and recovery [d5568077s1p0].
GPP includes rehabilitation of injured muscles, strengthening lagging muscles and improvement of technique [d5568077s1p0].
This preparation readies athletes for more intense work such as explosive plyometrics [d5568077s1p0].
